answer.says: Ramesh, the sun has gone. I have no food, and I have not paid you for the week. I am ashamed. I have only three hundred rupees in my pocket, but I will give you what I can and I will make good the rest. Please, just make me a pot of rice and some vegetables. I will not sleep well otherwise.
answer.thought: The body has been neglected for four hours, and the hunger is now a sharp, specific claim that outweighs my pride. I cannot feed a man who has not been paid, but I can command my own dignity to beg for a simple meal. The dialectic of need and obligation is too abstract to solve the immediate ache in my stomach; I must act on the immediate.
